theme_strategy.primary_color_logic: Gold/Bronze for luxury, Deep Black/Charcoal for background

mono.family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

usage_rules.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for spotlights on food items.
usage_rules.transparency: Use glassmorphism (bg-black/40 + backdrop-blur-md) for sticky headers and overlays.
usage_rules.borders: Use 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/10) for cards. Highlight active elements with Gold (border-primary/50).

layout_strategies.spacing_scale: Use 2x standard spacing. Minimum padding for sections: py-24 or py-32.

grid_system.marketing: Use 'Tetris' grid (asymmetric) for food showcase. Mix large hero images with smaller detail shots.
grid_system.menu: Use 'Bento' grid for categories. Responsive masonry or clean grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 for items.
grid_system.admin: High density. Sidebar navigation + Topbar. Content area padding p-8.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300 font-medium tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: border border-input bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border shadow-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300
cards.menu_item: Image aspect-square or 4:3. Title Playfair Display. Price in Gold. Add to Cart button subtle.

navigation.header: Sticky, glassmorphism. Logo on left (Playfair), Links centered or right. Cart icon with badge.
navigation.footer: Massive padding (py-24). Simple columns. Logo text-6xl opacity-20.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-4 placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 transition-all

motion.rules: Disable animations if 'prefers-reduced-motion' is set. No 'transition: all'.

icons.style: stroke-width=1.5 for elegance, 2 for UI controls

instructions_to_main_agent: STEP 1: Update '/app/frontend/src/index.css' with the defined Color Palette (HSL variables) and Font Imports. Ensure Dark Mode is default.
STEP 3: Create a Layout Component (Layout.js) that includes the Navbar (Glassmorphism) and Footer (Massive).
STEP 4: Build the Home Page (Landing) using the 'Tetris' grid layout and Parallax Hero with the provided interior images.
STEP 5: Build the Menu Page. Use Tabs for categories (Indian, Chinese, Continental). Use the 'menu_item' card style defined in components.
STEP 6: Implement the Cart & Checkout flow using Shadcn Dialog/Sheet components for Cart and a clean Form for Checkout.
STEP 7: Build the Admin Dashboard. Use a Sidebar layout. Secure it with the JWT auth logic required.
STEP 8: Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
